
### Linux's ss command  {.smaller}


<pre><code>$ ss --info --numeric --tcp state established
...
Recv-Q  Send-Q   Local Address:Port         Peer Address:Port 
0       2583232  128.143.71.27:5201         128.143.63.240:55926
<em>cubic</em> wscale:7,7 rto:204 <em>rtt:1.891/0.125</em> ato:40 <em>mss:1448</em> pmtu:1500
rcvmss:536 advmss:1448 <em>cwnd:309 ssthresh:64</em> bytes_sent:152936312
bytes_acked:152698840 bytes_received:37 segs_out:105620 segs_in:7024
data_segs_out:105619 data_segs_in:1 send 1.89Gbps lastrcv:1312
pacing_rate 2.27Gbps delivery_rate 996Mbps delivered:105456
busy:1308ms unacked:164 rcv_space:14600 rcv_ssthresh:64076
notsent:2345760 minrtt:0.219
</code></pre>
 

* <code>cubic</code> = which congestion control algorithm
* <code>cwnd</code> = 309 segments; <code>ssthresh</code> = 64 segments
* cwnd = 309 segments $\times$ 1488B max segment size = 437 KiB
* packet rate $\approx$ cwnd / rtt = 224 MiB/sec = 1879 Mbit/s
